metadata.title: Hypervelocity Stars from a Supermassive Black Hole-Intermediate-mass Black Hole binary

notes: No individual star meets the eligibility criteria. The paper is a theoretical study of ejection mechanisms and simulated stellar populations; it does not select, analyze, or follow up any identifiable star. HVS3 is mentioned only in background at T:p1-b12, two LMC-origin HVS candidates are cited generically at T:p3-b4, and three candidate HVS white dwarfs are cited generically at T:p3-b10, without individual identifiers or star-specific analysis.
